course_name_original: Creación de Empresas de Base Tecnológica
prerequisites: It is preferable that students have already passed the first-year common subject 'Empresa' (Company).
It is preferable that students have passed several technology-related subjects directly linked to their future profession.

learning_outcomes.text: Integrate and provide a commercial vision to the knowledge from other technological subjects.
Put into practice interpersonal skills related to teamwork (leadership, communication, group management, negotiation...) in any professional activity.
Relate with real external agents to the University (suppliers, customers, financial entities...) and know the organizations and support instruments for entrepreneurs.
Foster the entrepreneurial spirit in any professional activity.
Put into practice business communication techniques.

syllabus_topics: Generalities: objectives, methodology and work plan of the subject.
The process of creating a technological micro-company: market study and business plan.
Environment to study, study approach and instruments.
Income statement (or profit and loss) and cash flow statement (or receipts and payments).

assessment_methods.method: Final exam: final presentation of the group project (EXA_FIN)

assessment_rules: For the ordinary assessment, if a minimum attendance of 75% is met, the final grade is calculated as: FINAL GRADE = PLAN_EMPRESA * 0.5 + EXA_FIN * 0.3 + PA * 0.2. If this formula yields at least 5 points, the subject is passed. Failure to meet minimum attendance results in a "No Presentado" grade. For extraordinary assessments, the final grade is calculated as: FINAL GRADE = PLAN_EMPRESA_EXTRA * 0.6 + EXA_EXTRA * 0.4. If this formula yields at least 5 points, the subject is passed. For extraordinary exams, the project topic must be communicated to the professor at least 4 weeks in advance, and the final business plan must be submitted 48 hours before the exam.
